Name: Kenneth's Vanilla Plus Crops
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Vanilla Plus Crops - Content Patcher[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod adds 7 new crops inspired by vanilla gameplay.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It includes Breeze Berry, Carrot, Fire Pepper, Golden Apple, Pea Pod, Rainbow and Sweet Corn.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Seeds are sold at Kenneth's Seed Shop.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod is balanced and designed to fit naturally into the game.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Seed Shop[/b][/size]
